segments.an6.97:1.3: Saddhammaniyato hoti, aparihānadhammo hoti, pariyantakatassa dukkhaṃ hoti [dukkhaṃ na hoti (syā. pī. ka.)], asādhāraṇena ñāṇena samannāgato hoti, hetu cassa sudiṭṭho, hetusamuppannā ca dhammā.
segments.an6.97:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cha ānisaṃsā sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāyā”ti.
